items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153 (includes BlockStrap)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, with CVE-2026-103849 being a critical template engine injection flaw (BlockStrap) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. Adobe recommends applying the patch, though no exploitation in the wild was known at the time of publication.

items.title: Incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-153, affects Adobe Commerce B2B and allows unauthenticated code execution due to an incorrect authorization flaw. It has a CVSS score of 9.8.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions, with mass attacks observed in October 2026. The bug involves session deserialization and arbitrary file uploads.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler zero-day)
items.summary: This emergency hotfix addresses a critical zero-day vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, which Adobe confirmed was being exploited in the wild. It involves improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This regular September bulletin resolves eight vulnerabilities, including six exploitable without authentication, which could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues at the time of publication.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This bulletin resolves seven vulnerabilities, five of which are critical, including CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover flaw with a CVSS score of 9.1. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento CVE-2026-48356 (PolyShell) Added to CISA KEV
items.summary: This critical file upload flaw, named 'PolyShell' by Sansec, could result in arbitrary code execution and was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in October 2026. Exploitation requires user interaction with a maliciously crafted URL or compromised web page.
